content: Hillingdon Hospital is a National Health Service (NHS) facility situated on Pield Heath Road in Uxbridge, Greater London. It functions as a general hospital, catering to the healthcare needs of the local community. The hospital offers a comprehensive range of medical services, including an Accident and Emergency (A&E) department that manages approximately 64,000 patients annually, inpatient care, day surgery, and outpatient clinics. Hillingdon Hospital is one of only two hospitals operated by the Hillingdon Hospital NHS Trust. Its mission is to deliver high-quality emergency and specialized care that is patient-centered, accessible, and responsive to the needs of the community. The hospital serves a diverse population comprising individuals from various ethnic backgrounds and religious beliefs. Additionally, the hospital is equipped with a helipad located on its roof, which facilitates the landing of air ambulances and private helicopters for emergency medical transport and other critical needs.
